title: Greek-Sahidic statistical aligner comparison + learning curves (JAK-36)

notes: Coptic = bound-group-v1 (v2 token ids); Greek = whitespace v1 ids.
Omission (John 8 PA) excluded from positive bitext.
Holdout units are never used as the training subset.
Thomas 7 / P.Oxy. 654 remain outside this NT training stack.

eflomal.name: eflomal
eflomal.detail: eflomal Python package importable; binary at /agent/repos/thomas/data/local/aligners/eflomal

fast_align.name: fast_align
fast_align.detail: fast_align at /agent/repos/thomas/data/local/aligners/fast_align; atools at /agent/repos/thomas/data/local/aligners/atools (optional; pure-Python symmetrize used)

human_reference.scoring: soft projection: segmented left onto whitespace gold left; right_norm exact

eflomal.protocol: joint unsupervised alignment of train_subset + dev; metrics on dev unit_ids only (dev is not sealed holdout)

intrinsic.notes: fwd_rev_agreement = |fwd&rev| / |fwd U rev| per sentence, averaged. density = symmetrized links / (src_len * trg_len). fertility = symmetrized links / src_len.

notes: eflomal Gibbs sampler uses OS entropy; seed is recorded for config provenance but does not fully pin C RNG.
Source=Sahidic (bound-group tokens), target=Greek (whitespace).
No LLM; offline after setup.

norm_gold.notes: Soft projection: segmented left matches whitespace gold left by equality or contiguous substring; right_norm must match exactly. Provisional gold only - not human-checked. Intrinsic agreement remains the primary bake-off metric.

fast_align.protocol: joint unsupervised alignment of train_subset + dev; metrics on dev unit_ids only (dev is not sealed holdout)

intrinsic.notes: fwd_rev_agreement = |fwd&rev| / |fwd U rev| per sentence, averaged. density = symmetrized links / (src_len * trg_len). fertility = symmetrized links / src_len.

notes: fast_align EM is deterministic for fixed -I / -d / -o / -v flags.
Reverse pass uses -r; pairs kept in left=source (Sahidic) coords.
Symmetrization: pure-Python grow-diag-final-and (atools optional).
No LLM; offline after setup.

norm_gold.notes: Soft projection: segmented left matches whitespace gold left by equality or contiguous substring; right_norm must match exactly. Provisional gold only - not human-checked. Intrinsic agreement remains the primary bake-off metric.

token_id_gold.notes: No pass/fail threshold. Denominators are predicted link count and gold link count after optional unit_id filter. Predictions restricted to gold-annotated left (Sahidic) token ids so partial gold does not conflate coverage with precision. Omission fixtures must not appear in these denominators. F1 is 0.0 when both denominators are nonzero and TP=0.

Aligned with frozen Dirichlet priors from train.priors.

fast_align.error: holdout scores omitted for fast_align: adapter has no frozen-prior / apply path; refusing joint train+holdout fit

jake_decision.question_for_jake: Adopt eflomal, adopt fast_align, or keep both available for Phase 2 lexical-table work (JAK-37+)? Evidence above; gold is provisional so do not treat F1 alone as decisive.
rationale: eflomal evaluated first per PLAN.md / JAK-36; not preselected.
Identical v3 train/dev/holdout + bound-group-v1 segmentation for both.
Full-train dev fwd↔rev agreement: eflomal=0.5001, fast_align=0.4172 (Δ=+0.0828).
eflomal leads on intrinsic agreement; still pending Jake adopt.

limitations: Provisional gold is tiny / unreviewed; intrinsic agreement is primary.
eflomal C sampler is stochastic; seed recorded but not fully pinning.
Dev curves use joint train+dev (dev is not sealed holdout).
Holdout: eflomal train-only priors then holdout-only align; fast_align holdout omitted (no apply path).
No LLM. Greek = Vaticanus B* only. PA omission never positive pairs.
Thomas 7 / P.Oxy. 654 excluded from training stack.
